logp.method_description: Using the shake-flask method, lipophilicity for the ruthenium complexes (1-3) has been determined in order to obtain information about the structure-activity relation [37]. The octanol water partition coefficients (P) of complexes 1-3 by shaking N-octanol (100 mL, ≈99%) and 50 milliliters of distilled water following milli-Q purification) for 48 hours to allow saturation of both phases. Aliquots (1 mL) of each of the three complexes' stock solutions (50 μM) were prepared in the aqueous phase and subsequently added to an equal volume of the n-octanol phase. After mixing the resulting biphasic solutions for an hour, the phases were separated by centrifugation. Using UV absorbance spectroscopy (260 nm), the complex concentrations in the organic and aqueous phases were then ascertained. The logarithm of the ratio of the concentrations of the ruthenium complex in the organic and aqueous phases (Log P; Log P =Complex_Org/〖Complex〗_Aq ) values were reported as the means of a minimum of two independent determinations.
